existingIntegrationPoint.at: resources.assets pathId320, after project_actor_display -> project_quest_display -> project_item_display -> project_quest_family -> optional project_descriptions, before assigning m_Script. Preserve the selected existing inventory option and all previous projections.
existingIntegrationPoint.newStage: Proposed project_gallery_chapter_display(data, parse, variable_cells, plan) with explicit locale and versioned113-ID accepted target plan; no implementation here.
existingIntegrationPoint.offsetRule: Parse the already localized input anew; the original source offsets in column-states are provenance only and must NEVER be used to patch an input whose earlier columns changed length.
existingIntegrationPoint.sourceCaches: The packaged payload must be loaded before manifest/record generation. Do not infer a running cache refreshed from an offline patch.

planRequirements: Exactly113 unique selected physical IDs, all3 column IDs and full129-state ledger; explicit locale with no default.

Bind original game/schema/payload, admission manifest, source113, complete state ledger, approved applicable source/target glossary, final authored target artifact and reviewed evidence hashes. Missing/extra/duplicate IDs or any stale source/target hash reject before mutation.

Each selected before value equals the exact original source bytes; target values must be nonempty/nonwhitespace and preserve display-only syntax and source decisions. Do not silently accept a mixture of original and target states.

Pin the full after-existing-projections input payload hash at plan preparation. Do not equate it to the original source hash or a stale build12 hash. Require upstream receipts matching the actual selected build; preserve their exact outputs.

Already-applied replay, if supported, requires the entire recorded output hash, exact113 target values, unchanged16 absent states and matching plan/version. Unknown or mixed state rejects; no substring detection, heuristic repair or source/target overlap shortcut.
encoding: For each selected column retain the original sparse count, stored row indices and order. Encode actual final target UTF-8 bytes; recompute cumulative byte ends, not codepoint counts.
Source spans address raw UTF-8 bytes; absent cells have no span. Preserve all16 absent states and the zero explicit stored-empty states. Never materialize omitted rows or normalize source whitespace.
Build replacement sparse blobs: int32 count + ordered(int32 rowIndex,int32 cumulativeEnd) + concatenated UTF-8 values. Recompute the enclosing int32 blob length.

Use current parsed offsets and replace selected columns in descending offset order. Preserve every unselected column and every framing/schema/ID byte outside the selected length/blob slots. Then parse the output anew.
postconditions: Exactly113 target values equal the pinned authored targets by ID; UTF-8 readback including punctuation/marks equals target bytes.
All129 states match the planned stored/absent/empty classification and all sparse row orders match.

All286 unselected columns are byte-identical to the immediate input, including existing localized Actor/Quest/QuestProgressLogText/InventoryItem columns. No change to Movie/Chapter names, savekeys, enums, parents, hide flags, tags, unlock data, respawn or manage_items.
Compare schema, sheet/field order and IDs, row IDs/order, all non-column framing and unselected fields. A schema-equivalence-only comparison is insufficient for byte preservation.

Replace ONLY the3 selected output blobs and their length words with the exact pre-stage input blobs at re-parsed output offsets. Require the ENTIRE restored payload == immediate input bytes and its hash. This restores the prior localized payload, not the original unlocalized payload.
Separately retain original-source restoration evidence. Never label source-only no-op reconstruction as proof of target projection or target-to-before restoration.
Save full input/output/plan hashes and per-ID source/target/readback receipts. Bind subsequent package/cache/font/runtime checks to this exact output.
commitBoundary: Build and validate the complete payload in memory, then write a task-owned staged file and atomically replace one destination only after all predicates pass. Resource package and separate receipts are not a multi-file transaction. A completion manifest written last must reference all validated artifacts; injected failure between writes leaves an incomplete handoff, never accepted partial success. Do not overwrite an existing accepted artifact to repair receipts.
